name: firewallOwnerDashboard
title: Firewall Owner Dashboard
subTitle: Comprehensive firewall management dashboard for device owners
description:
A comprehensive dashboard widget for firewall device owners to monitor firewall status, policies, changes, and announcements. Features include:
- Real-time firewall status monitoring with HA, CPU, and memory metrics
- Policy hit analysis with 24-hour statistics
- Planned maintenance and change tracking
- Announcement management with severity levels
- Filtering by ADOM and role
- Interactive firewall selection
- Contact information display
